claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing entitlement for this Copilot Studio maker capability is unknown because feature-specific licensing is unpublished.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations:
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the blanket licensing gap with: 'Existing Copilot Studio access entitlements apply. Microsoft lists a Copilot Studio user license with a tenant prepaid pack, the Copilot Studio authors configuration for applicable pay-as-you-go scenarios, a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, or a trial license; trial licenses cannot publish agents. Feature-specific entitlement restrictions and analysis charges are not yet published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing. Narrow the licensing gaps in Scope, Open questions and the cost rationale to feature-specific restrictions or charges; do not describe the product's access entitlement as unpublished.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate price or metering rule for self-learning analysis, or statement that it is free, was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "self-learning" "Copilot Studio" identity data runs pricing default switch. Read https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management; no self-learning price or inclusion statement.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the documented unit measuring Copilot Studio agent usage.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the unit that measures agent usage.

claims.claim: Agent flows are predefined flow-action sequences for repetitive tasks without agent reasoning and orchestration at each step.
claims.quote: predefined sequences of flow actions to execute repetitive tasks quickly, without requiring agent reasoning and orchestration at each step.

claims.claim: The billing page lists an additional reasoning-model premium of 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 tokens.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are calculated from the exact number of billed tokens, at 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 tokens.
claims.fix: Replace the reasoning-model rate sentence with: 'For billable standard-harness reasoning-model usage, the page lists an additional 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 billed tokens, excluding tokens read from the prompt cache; eligible authenticated Microsoft 365 Copilot employee-facing usage is included in that licence, subject to fair usage limits and exclusions.' This remains background pricing, not a verified rate for self-learning.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly credit limit is set in Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote:
In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio.
2. Select Manage Agents.
3. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: No documented API operation for setting an individual agent's monthly limit was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio agent monthly consumption limit API Power Platform Dataverse limit Stop usage; "agent" "monthly" "limit" "api.powerplatform.com". Opened the programmatic credit-allocation tutorial and Dataverse bot reference; no per-agent limit setter.

claims.claim: Stopping the agent at its monthly limit is optional through Stop usage.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Monthly agent limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls.

claims.claim: The monthly limit is a general per-agent Copilot Studio consumption control, not a self-learning switch.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: An agent monthly limit can be accompanied by a notification threshold.
claims.quote:
Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.
5. Configure the notification threshold.
